name: scene-decomposer
author: VORTEX-OS
description: Reads a source document (markdown / script / brief) and produces a structured scene manifest + production bible. The T1 director.cinematic calls this once per dispatch. Falls back to a rule-based H2-heading splitter when the LLM is unavailable.

source_markdown.description: Absolute path to the source markdown / script file

title.description: Project title (defaults to the source filename without extension)

target_duration_s.description: Target total duration in seconds. The decomposer will produce enough scenes to hit this.

max_scene_s.description: Max duration of any one scene (Hailuo-2.3 caps at 10s; H3 at 15s; default 8 leaves headroom)

palette.default: cool teal and warm amber, low contrast

characters.description: Optional pre-defined character descriptions, one per line, format: 'name | description | voice'

manifest_path.description: Absolute path to the production_bible.json + scenes.json written under the project's state dir

provider.description: Which path produced the manifest: 'minimax-llm' (primary) or 'rule-based' (fallback)

primary.name: minimax-llm
primary.notes: MiniMax Text-01 via the SDK's Invoke-MiniMaxLLM helper. The LLM is given the source + target_duration + max_scene + aspect + style + palette + characters and asked to return a JSON scene list + production bible.

fallbacks.name: rule-based
fallbacks.notes: Splits the source on H2 headings, then on H3 if there are no H2s, then on blank-line paragraphs if there are no H3s. Each section becomes one scene at max_scene_s. Character / palette / style inputs are honored verbatim.
